name: Bendigo TAFE Access Scholarship (enrolled students)
summary: Financial help for enrolled Bendigo TAFE students, domestic or international, facing financial pressure that threatens their study.
who: Domestic and international students enrolled in any Bendigo TAFE course
how: Apply through the online form linked from the scholarships page and email supporting documents to the welfare team
catches: Amount not stated on the page

evidence.quote: The scholarship is available to domestic and international students enrolled in any course at Bendigo TAFE.
The Bendigo TAFE Access Scholarship has been designed to provide opportunities for access to education.
